title: UI风格#202 - Neon Genesis (霓虹创世纪)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Neon Genesis style When color palette Then features deep purple, violet, orange, stark white

acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：极简构图、发光点缀、深空氛围
